blogs.title: Finetuning Giant Language Models on One GPU: The QLoRA Breakthrough
blogs.description: An introductory overview that explains why finetuning massive LLMs has been so resource‑intensive, and how QLoRA manages to shrink memory needs enough to fine‑tune a 65‑billion‑parameter model on a single 48 GB GPU without losing quality.

blogs.title: Inside NF4: The 4‑bit NormalFloat Data Type That Saves Memory and Boosts Accuracy
blogs.description: A deep‑dive into the new NF4 quantization scheme—its statistical foundations, how it differs from traditional int4/float4 formats, and why it’s theoretically optimal for the normally‑distributed weights of large language models.

blogs.title: Double Quantization & Paged Optimizers: Cutting the Last Bits of Memory Overhead
blogs.description: Explains the two clever engineering tricks that make QLoRA practical—quantizing the quantization constants themselves (double quantization) and using NVIDIA’s unified memory to page optimizer states (paged optimizers), keeping training spikes in check.

blogs.title: From Research to Chatbot Stardom: How QLoRA Powers the Guanaco Models
blogs.description: Shows how the authors leveraged QLoRA to train the open‑source Guanaco series, compares their Vicuna benchmark scores to ChatGPT/GPT‑4, and discusses what this means for open‑source chatbot development.

blogs.title: Step‑by‑Step Guide: Fine‑tuning a 7B Model with QLoRA on Your Own GPU
blogs.description: A practical tutorial that walks readers through setting up the environment, installing the bitsandbytes kernels, preparing LoRA adapters, and running a full QLoRA finetune—all with just a consumer‑grade GPU.

blogs.title: Democratizing LLM Fine‑Tuning: What QLoRA Means for Researchers and Entrepreneurs
blogs.description: Analyzes the broader impact of making 33B/65B model finetuning accessible—how it levels the playing field for small teams, enables on‑device customization, and raises new ethical considerations around dual‑use technology.
